title: A dramatic farewell
odia:
ଛାଡ଼ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ମହାବାହୁ...
ଏ ଜନ୍ମେ ଭେଟ ନାହିଁ ଆଉ...!!!
literal_meaning: Let go of my garment’s end, mighty-armed one; in this life we shall meet no more.
explanation: The source places this farewell under distress that feels unbearable. Its absolute language gives the parting a dramatic finality.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଃଖ ସହି ନପାରି ବିଦାୟ ନେବାର ଭାବକୁ ଆଉ କେବେ ଭେଟ ହେବନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ତୀବ୍ର କରାଯାଇଛି।
usage_example: A performer uses the line to portray a wounded character’s farewell; the scene is newly imagined. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The witness names no underlying song or episode. Mahabahu is rendered literally; no particular speaker or deity is assigned.
